comment: do.c menu_drop() 1012: justpicked_quan = max(0, pick_list[i].count) for the 'P' (items just picked up) category with a count above 2^53. The tty menu returns that long count exactly; C drops the one just-picked stack whole, as the count exceeds its quantity. The port applied Math.max() to the count, which a tty count above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER makes a BigInt, and threw. A debug-mode Ranger drops and picks up her cram rations first. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
